title: Count Word Frequency in a Sentence
statement: Given a sentence, return how many times each word appears. Ignore case.
think: What is the task asking? Count occurrences of each word.
What is the key operation? Map each normalized word to its count.
What wording signals stand out? Count words, frequency, appears.
What is the brute force idea? For each word, rescan the sentence.
What is the better/optimal idea? Split into words and increment counts in a dictionary.
What are the edge cases? Mixed case, repeated spaces, punctuation handling policy.
What is the complexity? O(n) over the words.
How would I explain it in an interview? I normalize words and build a frequency map from word to count.
algorithm: Split sentence into words removing empty entries
Normalize each word to lower case
Increment count for each word in Dictionary<string,int>
interview: I would split the sentence into words, normalize them, and use a dictionary to count how often each word appears.
ru: Это уже frequency map не по char, а по word. Смысл тот же: слово -> count.

critical: Treat same word in different case as different

gaps: Nice to have: think about normalization rules
constraints: Assume words are separated by spaces.
whyThisPattern: This is a Dictionary problem because each unique word needs an associated count.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Sliding Window, because there is no moving segment.
